description: This PHP file defines a class EmailsViewDetailNonImported that extends ViewDetail, responsible for managing the display of a 'detail' view for non-imported emails in the SuiteCRM system. It handles pre-display setup and delegates rendering to a EmailsNonImportedDetailView object, including loading view metadata and extracting fields for display.

classes.name: EmailsViewDetailNonImported
classes.description: A class extending ViewDetail to provide customized detail view handling for non-imported email records.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets the view type to 'NonImportedDetail' and calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the view by loading view definitions, initializing the EmailsNonImportedDetailView object, and setting up the focus bean.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Triggers the process and display methods of the detail view object to render the view.

methods.name: getFieldsInViewDefinitions
methods.description: Loads and parses the metadata view definition file to extract field names for the 'Emails' module's DetailView panels.
